findings.next_action: Use read-only permissions; reserve release-write for trusted tag releases; never use write-all.
findings.rationale: write-all is never permitted. release-write is permitted only when trigger=tag and runs_untrusted_code=false.

findings.next_action: Disable log_environment and rotate any active secret that may have been logged.
